page.meta_description: The Aqua-Lung let divers stay down with tanks instead of surface air, the hardware behind Cousteau's films and a generation of reef science. Related pages:…
page.content:
Open-circuit scuba regulator Cousteau and Gagnan patented.

How Aqua-Lung connects

  • Character: Jacques Cousteau — Cousteau co-invented the Aqua-Lung with Émile Gagnan.

What is Aqua-Lung?

The Aqua-Lung let divers stay down with tanks instead of surface air, the hardware behind Cousteau's films and a generation of reef science.

Key threads lead to Jacques Cousteau.
